Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def is_palindrome(text):
    left, right = 0, len(text) - 1
    while left < right:
        if text[left] != text[right]: return False
        left += 1; right -= 1
    return True

assert is_palindrome("racecar")
assert not is_palindrome("python")
```
explanation: Compare matching characters from the two ends. Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1); normalization/case-folding is a separate requirement if desired.
